info.name: Retrieve preprint details by date interval

params.name: server
params.description: The preprint server to query. Use 'medrxiv' for medRxiv preprints or 'biorxiv' for bioRxiv preprints.

params.name: interval
params.description: The date interval to query. Can be two dates in YYYY-MM-DD/YYYY-MM-DD format, a numeric value for N most recent posts, or a number followed by 'd' for the most recent N days (e.g., '7d' for last 7 days).

params.name: cursor
params.description: Starting position for pagination. Defaults to 0. Increment by 100 to retrieve successive pages of results.

params.name: format
params.description: The response format. Use 'json' for JSON or 'xml' for OAI-PMH XML.

items.docs: Returns preprint metadata for papers posted within the specified interval. Results are paginated with 100 records per call. Use the cursor parameter to page through the full result set.

params.name: server
params.description: The preprint server to query. Use 'medrxiv' for medRxiv preprints or 'biorxiv' for bioRxiv preprints.

params.name: doi
params.description: The Digital Object Identifier (DOI) of the preprint to retrieve. Do not include the 'https://doi.org/' prefix.

params.name: format
params.description: The response format. Use 'json' for JSON or 'xml' for OAI-PMH XML.

items.docs: Returns metadata for a single preprint identified by its DOI. All versions of the preprint are returned in the collection array.
